Lightsaber Combat Styles

Choose Lightsaber for strikes that weaken enemy defenses or for wards that protect an ally.

Lightsaber - Severance

Severance favors pressure with Force-enhanced next-hit attacks and strikes that reduce an enemy's defenses.

Lightsaber - Ward

Ward favors protecting an ally: Saber Ward improves your defenses, while its link redirects part of that ally's incoming damage to you.

Quick Answers

What does Lightsaber focus on?

Choose Lightsaber for strikes that weaken enemy defenses or for wards that protect an ally.
